title: KTF-001: Daylight unattended Builder proof (Outcome 6)
description: Operator-gated daylight proof. Requires KTF-RP-01/02 evidence, Builder doctor green, and the canonical checkout. Two self-documenting free-exec packets prove the initiative runner processes unrelated eligible work and safely pauses on provider exhaustion.

packets.title: Verify daylight proof prerequisites
packets.objective:
Execution class: free-exec. One outcome only: create docs/research/ktf-004-daylight-prerequisite-verification.md recording that all daylight-run preconditions are met before the unattended initiative run begins.

Step 1 — require all checks pass. These must exit 0 before any file is written; if any fails, write nothing and fail the attempt:
  git merge-base --is-ancestor f9dfb6a HEAD
  test -s docs/research/ktf-004-current-main-runtime-proof.md
  grep -q 'controlled runtime proof: passed' docs/research/ktf-004-current-main-runtime-proof.md
  grep -q 'unrelated continuation: passed' docs/research/ktf-004-current-main-runtime-proof.md
  grep -q 'provider exhaustion exit 75: passed' docs/research/ktf-004-current-main-runtime-proof.md
  test -s docs/research/ktf-004-daylight-operator-brief.md
  test -s docs/initiatives/ktf-004-verify-inspected-head.sh
  test -s docs/initiatives/ktf-004-verify-daylight-operator-brief.sh
  sh docs/initiatives/ktf-004-verify-daylight-operator-brief.sh
  ./kitty builder initiative doctor --json

Step 2 — if all checks pass, write docs/research/ktf-004-daylight-prerequisite-verification.md with exactly these lines in this order:
  daylight-prerequisite-verification: passed
  ktf-rp-01-report: present
  ktf-rp-02-brief: present
  builder-doctor: pass
  inspected-head: <git rev-parse HEAD>
  prerequisites-verified-at: <date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ>

STOPPING RULE: if any Step-1 check fails, make no change and fail the attempt. Do not write a partial or alternative verification file. Do not edit any other file, apply a manifest, run Builder, claim a task, push, or create a PR.
acceptance_criteria: The verification report exists only after all prerequisite checks pass.
The report records the git HEAD and timestamp at verification time.
No source, test, manifest, Builder, Git remote, or GitHub state is changed.

packets.title: Capture daylight unattended run evidence
packets.objective:
Execution class: free-exec. One outcome only: after KTF-DP-01 prerequisite verification exists, write docs/research/ktf-004-daylight-run-evidence.md recording the KTF-DP-01-verify-prerequisites-proto task/attempt/lease receipts and a snapshot of the Builder queue state.

Step 1 — require KTF-DP-01-verify-prerequisites-proto completed evidence:
  test -s docs/research/ktf-004-daylight-prerequisite-verification.md
  grep -q 'daylight-prerequisite-verification: passed' docs/research/ktf-004-daylight-prerequisite-verification.md

Step 2 — collect evidence by running these commands and capturing their output:
  ./kitty builder queue status --json
  ./kitty builder initiative status ktf-004-daylight-proof-v1 --json
  git log --oneline -3

Step 3 — write docs/research/ktf-004-daylight-run-evidence.md containing:
  daylight-run-evidence: captured
  initiative: ktf-004-daylight-proof-v1
  packet: KTF-DP-02-capture-daylight-run-evidence-proto
  inspected-head: <git rev-parse HEAD>
  captured-at: <date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ>
  queue-status: <truncated first 30 lines of queue status>
  initiative-status: <truncated first 30 lines of initiative status>
  recent-commits: <the git log output>

Step 4 — run these validation commands to prove the evidence is present:
  git merge-base --is-ancestor f9dfb6a HEAD
  ./kitty builder initiative doctor --json

STOPPING RULE: if Step 1 or Step 4 fails, make no change and fail the attempt. Do not write a partial evidence file. Do not edit source, tests, manifests, or other research files. Do not apply another manifest, claim an extra task, push, or create a PR.
acceptance_criteria: The evidence report is written only after the prerequisite verification exists.
The report captures the queue and initiative snapshot at run time.
No source, test, manifest, Builder database, Git remote, or GitHub state is changed.
